scope_help: This page lists chats with Persona. The total excludes archived chats and stays the same when you search or filter. Archived shows the number of archived chats that match.
empty_body: Say something to Persona and the chat will show up here.
search_partial: Still going through older chats; some may not show yet.
archived_footer: Archiving only hides a chat from the list; it's still there. Send a message in an archived chat and it moves back to the list.
rename_hint: A title you set won't be replaced by an automatic one.
